My Work at W&B 🎯
----------------
➡️ Working at Weights and Biases on a Contract basis under the Kaggle Ambassador Program (KAP).

➡️ Engineering Optimised Deep Learning Training and Inference Kernels with added support for W&B tracking and monitoring tools.


About Weights and Biases
--------------------------
Weights & Biases is the machine learning platform for developers to build better models faster. Use W&B's lightweight, interoperable tools to quickly track experiments, version and iterate on datasets, evaluate model performance, reproduce models, visualize results and spot regressions, and share findings with colleagues.
